data.key: Monk of the Sacred Mountain ~ Iron Monk
data.name: Iron Monk
data.description: At 2nd level, a monk of the sacred mountain gains Toughness as a bonus feat. In addition, the monk gains a +1 natural armor bonus. This ability replaces evasion.
